notes.title: CURBS!
notes.content:
Happy New Year! Our first major update of the year brings curb geometry to our city streets!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35321477/29fbfba1284ac8f6c1d4ddbf7f25d6edca18d63b.png[/img]

Back when Rise was first in development it was very flight-centric ... the idea that we could go from orbit all the way down to the ground (without cut-scenes, etc) was pretty revolutionary and quite taxing on the technology of the time (almost 20 years ago!). The surface detail, while resolution of the texturing increased over the years, never really kept up with the times (AKA other games). 

While we added high-resolution city streets and bump/elevation layers to simulate the vertical displacement of the curbs, the curbs were never visualized as three-dimensional which always caused confusion and frustration as to why people were flipping their cars, grunting, and dying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35321477/211fcac9783586085719f141a6ca90293ca4fe1c.png[/img]

notes.title: Portal Upgrades, Uplink Contracts
notes.content:
The [url=https://portal.risetvp.com]Player Portal[/url] now shows the Deois TCA, airfield colony Class G airspace, and navigational fixes. We also added a scale bar to the lower left corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35321477/101f008882db0e174c96de5698c9b0c1a1c64e31.png[/img]

You can now demolish road segments using the portal and recover about 25% of the materials. 

There was a big effort to upgrade OpenLayers to the latest version on the player portal.

Colonists are now pooled at the Territory level in preparation for commercial ticketing. This means you no longer have to manage the working population at a colony level. Labor is assigned based on labor required and their families are assigned based on number of beds available. This means, in theory, someone can work a your mine but then go "home" to their apartment in your township or vice-versa.

So that you retain some control over production and operating costs you can now "mothball" individual colonies (skeleton crew, no production, lights stay on, beds are usable) and "shuttered" (no colonists, no production, no operating costs, no lights).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35321477/9632a4ebc503fad7dac7d4aba7ba0b83a4607513.png[/img]

To help maintain the timeliness of the player portal information, the [url=https://www.risetvp.com/United_Stellar_Republic]United Stellar Republic[/url] is offering contracts to install [url=https://www.risetvp.com/Uplink]colony uplinks[/url] at territories where no functional uplink exists. You can find and accept these contracts under the Contracts tab on the player portal.

Other updates of note:
[list]
[*] Automated flights post to the new [url=https://discord.gg/SEK8ETUKtb]#flight-information[/url] channel on our [url=https://discord.gg/BH6zvaw]Discord Server[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.risetvp.com/Runway]Runway[/url] demolition is now supported through the [url=https://www.risetvp.com/Intermedia]Intermedia menu[/url]
[*] Fix for food spoilage in vehicles and PODS
[*] Allow [url=https://www.risetvp.com/JVC]JVC radios[/url] to be installed in aircraft and aerospace vehicles
[*] New toast added for errors when zoning for a public airfield with no airport identifier
[*] Passengers can now be loaded with mixed destinations in the same vehicle or PODS
[/list]

notes.title: 2.2.18.8 Dock Telemetry Update
notes.content:
Biggest change is the dock telemetry. We used to calculate the position once per frame based on an epoch and the orbital parameters. Now the server actually runs these calculations and progresses the orbit and synchronizes the epoch with the client when you log in! This was done to reduce slight precision errors we have seen develop over the last 15 years since the server was started. It also lightens the computational load that the client is responsible for!

notes.title: Discord Rich Presence and Demo Limits
notes.content:
Demo Limits which are now enforced server-side! But the good news is that Rise is on sale for 25% off during the Steam Summer Sale until July 9.

[list]
[*] Demo players may not create an alliance.
[*] Demo players may not customize their vehicles (trim color, hull registry, vanity plates).
[*] Demo players are not allowed to buy plots of land (and therefore cannot construct colonies).
[*] Demo players can not earn interest at the bank.
[*] Demo players may not trade commodity futures.
[*] Demo players may not accept (or eventually post) contracts on the portal.
[/list]

notes.title: An "Explosive" Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35321477/6a842046b8d23e413732cb1fc7c8b687b0a63e53.png[/img]

After months of research and reading theoretical mathematics papers explaining how explosions propagate through open air we now have added the realistic explosion of the “Longarm" Missiles, the “Munitions" cargo container, and the "Auxiliary Fuel" container. 

The Longarms have been determined to each have an equivalent yield of 570 kg of TNT.

Munitions containers explode with a yield based on the quantity of Longarms they are carrying. 

An Auxilary Fuel container that is full and dropped from height or shot with a Longarm will explode with an equivalent yield of 745 MT of TNT

While working on the Longarm explosive payload the question was asked “How much damage will 12 kg of Iagreous fuel do?”. We then took the MJ/kg and converted the energy to kg of TNT.  Approximately 15 minutes into the yield calculations someone asked “What happens if you explode a full Auxiliary Fuel container?” That brought out how dangerous it would be to shoot a full Auxiliary Fuel container. 

The next steps will be to move and toss the offline vehicles affected by the explosions as well as calculate impacts between two vehicles.

notes.title: T-19 Stratomaster Update
notes.content:
We have cleared many hurdles but the replacement for the T-2 Stratoranger aircraft is getting ready for flight testing. Preliminary numbers confirm that it is sleeker and safer than it's predecessor. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35321477/94e42536b5ee0b88665411ce0d3b4fc3e78c3514.png[/img]

To give you an idea of the process we come up with a requirement (VTOL vs. wheeled, air vs. space capable, cargo capacity) and a preliminary design that fits those specifications. Then the artist constructs it in our proprietary modeling program which does baked lighting (for speed), rigging (for animations), and a virtual wind tunnel (for aerodynamics). We then take the numbers we come up with and plug them into the attached spreadsheet. This can be iterative as the CG might need to be adjusted or surfaces that are designated as control surfaces expanded. Finally (the stage we are at now) we have numbers we can plug into the game engine and let our QA take it for a test drive in the simulator. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35321477/32bfa5b5bab01b5ed97345441194391fec89de4a.png[/img]

If there are no red flags we might be seeing these flown by test pilots in the game within a week!

[b]Steam users will be given vouchers to upgrade their tired T-1 Stratoranger to the new T-19 Stratomaster[/b]
